description: This file contains the source code for the Materialize CSS framework's JavaScript components, including utility functions, class definitions for components like Collapsible, and initialization logic for Materialize components. It also includes code for DOM manipulation, event handling, animations, and component management using the cash DOM library.

classes.name: Component
classes.description: A generic base class for Materialize components that manages instantiation, destruction, and instance retrieval for DOM elements.

classes.name: Collapsible
classes.description: A component class for managing collapsible/accordion UI elements, handling open/close animations, event handling, and state management.

classes.name: Collapsible
classes.description: Component class for managing collapsible/accordion UI elements, handling open/close animations, event handling, and state management.

classes.name: Dropdown
classes.description: Component class for managing dropdown menus, with options for alignment, hover behavior, animation durations, and event callbacks.

classes.name: Modal
classes.description: Component class for managing modal dialogs, including overlay handling, animations, focus trapping, and support for nested modals.

classes.name: Materialbox
classes.description: Component class for managing scalable image lightboxes with animations, overlays, and caption handling.

classes.name: Parallax
classes.description: Component class for implementing parallax scrolling effects on images, responsive to window resize and scroll events.

classes.name: Tabs
classes.description: Component class for tabbed navigation, supporting swipeable carousels, content swapping, and animated indicators.

classes.name: Tooltip
classes.description: Component class for managing tooltip UI elements, including positioning, delays, animations, and interactions such as hover and focus.

classes.name: Waves
classes.description: Utility object for creating ripple effects on click or touch events for visual feedback.

classes.name: Toast
classes.description: Class for creating toast notifications with auto-dismiss, swipe-to-dismiss, and customizable timing.

classes.name: Sidenav
classes.description: Component class for side navigation panels, supporting overlay, fixed positioning, swipe gestures, and responsive behavior.

classes.name: ScrollSpy
classes.description: Component class for updating navigation states based on scroll position, highlighting active sections.

classes.name: Autocomplete
classes.description: Component class for providing autocomplete suggestions based on user input, supporting custom data sets and sorting.

classes.name: Slider
classes.description: Component class for image/content sliders with indicators, autoplay, captions, and transition effects.

classes.name: Chips
classes.description: Component class for creating, managing, and deleting chips/tags with optional autocomplete support.

classes.name: Pushpin
classes.description: Component class for toggling fixed position (pinning) behavior of elements based on scroll position.

classes.name: FloatingActionButton
classes.description: Component class for implementing floating action buttons with expand/collapse animations, position, and toolbar modes.

classes.name: Datepicker
classes.description: Date selection UI component with configurable date ranges, formats, internationalization, and callbacks.

classes.name: Datepicker
classes.description: Class implementing the date selection widget, managing calendar rendering, date parsing, event handling, modal display, and configuration options.

classes.name: Timepicker
classes.description: Class implementing the time selection widget with analog and digital interfaces, supporting 12-hour/24-hour formats, callbacks, and interactive clock controls.

classes.name: CharacterCounter
classes.description: Component class for character count input fields, providing live updates, validation, and dynamic UI feedback.

classes.name: Carousel
classes.description: Component class for image/content carousels, supporting swipe, drag, indicators, responsive sizing, and transition effects.

classes.name: TapTarget
classes.description: Component class for feature discovery overlays, managing positioning, opening, and closing tap target prompts.

classes.name: FormSelect
classes.description: Component class for stylized select dropdowns, supporting multiple selections, optgroups, and custom rendering.

classes.name: Range
classes.description: Component class for range input sliders, managing thumb interaction, dynamic bubble display, and responsive positioning.
